description: This Java class 'Wizard' provides a GUI component for a trigger configuration wizard, including steps to send commands and wait for RPM to reach zero, utilizing Swing components and external project classes.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Main class implementing a GUI wizard for trigger testing and configuration, with nested classes for wizard steps and command execution.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Interface defining a method to get GUI content for each wizard step.

classes.name: WizardStepImpl
classes.description: Abstract class implementing WizardStep, providing chainable next step setting.

classes.name: SendCommand
classes.description: Wizard step that sends a command via CommandQueue and proceeds after confirmation.

classes.name: WaitForZeroRpm
classes.description: Wizard step that waits until RPM sensor reads zero before proceeding.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Creates and returns the main GUI panel for the wizard.

methods.name: applyStep
methods.description: Updates GUI content to reflect the current wizard step.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves GUI component for a given wizard step.

methods.name: scheduleRepaint
methods.description: Schedules a GUI update after a delay, used for polling RPM sensor.
